title: Yammy Jammy: summer in a bottle
description: Summer in the city, I want freshness, so we cooked a new milkshake with a banana.

blocks.html:
Summer in the city, I want freshness, so we cooked a new milkshake with a banana.

Yammy Jammy Milkshake IPA with a cloudy, silky body and rich banana flavor. American hops "Magnum", "Columbus", "Pecco" and "Comet" added tropical notes of mango, passion fruit and pineapple. Thanks to lactose, creaminess appeared in the taste, and wheat malt added softness and balance. The ale was light, with a rich taste of ripe bananas.

We recommend you to try it with soft cheeses, grilled white meat or seafood, chocolate ice cream.

ABV 5,0%
Available in 20 l kegs and 0.5 l bottles. — Order.
